meta.title: The Stars & Stories Cosmos
meta.subtitle: A map of the worlds Izzy and Dad reached by potion, 2024–2026
meta.law: Potions are something you drink and then you say a rhyme and then they teleport you somewhere. That’s how they work.
meta.note: Every voyage, however far, folds back into pajamas and blankets — a going-home potion always returns them to bed.

worlds.name: Izzy’s Bedroom
worlds.curatedDescription: Izzy's bedroom is the real-world hearth of the whole cosmos, told in the dark under a star projector that scatters suns and polka dots across the ceiling. Inside the stories it becomes a magical destination in its own right: a house that feels like a little hotel of many rooms, whose floor is a soft blue rug covered with white stars, where travelers land after drinking a potion. Just above is Izzy's attic, a workshop of Legos, drawing pads, suitcases, and heavy work desks where the friends build robots and draw pictures of magical creatures and skyships.

potion.name: the Izzy's house potion
potion.rhyme: Hulooska, Kulooska, Kaloom. Mooska, Gadooska, Kaloom.
potion.mechanic: Seeker and Uncle Crisco drink the potion back at the castle and say the rhyme, arriving with a whoosh and a floof on the starry blue rug in Izzy's room.

worlds.arrivalFrom: Seeker's Castle / Potion Closet — travelers drink a potion to arrive here, though it is itself the real frame where every voyage begins and ends

worlds.name: Seeker’s Castle & the Potion Closet
worlds.curatedDescription: Behind an unassuming facade with a single doorbell lies Seeker's sprawling stone fortress, home to a towering library of mystical books and, hidden behind a secret door, the potion closet that is the true gateway to adventure. Its dusty shelves hold finished potions that shimmer in every color, kept separate from the ingredients and the potion tunnel. A sky ship floats parked at the top of a tower, from which you can see the whole countryside — Hattie's workshop, the ocean, and Dimitar's circular island. It is the hub where friends ring the doorbell with a problem, and where every voyage folds back home to a warm and cozy living room.

potion.name: going-home potion
potion.mechanic: The hidden potion closet is the launch point — drink a potion and say a rhyme to travel out; every adventure ends by taking a 'going-home potion' back to the castle.

worlds.arrivalFrom: the launch hub itself — every potion voyage begins in the closet and every going-home potion returns here

worlds.name: Hattie’s Workshop
worlds.curatedDescription: Hattie the Mouse's workshop sits inside the cozy hollow of a weathered tree on Cornell Street, an atelier humming with the snip of scissors and cluttered with measuring tapes, wet paints, feathers, cardboard, and a glowing store of red, orange, and yellow mushrooms, all beneath a haunting indigo witch painting. Here Hattie makes hats of every kind — teeny tiny or enormous, out of Legos, blocks, paper, cardboard, fur, or feathers — for a steady stream of visiting friends. She measures each customer, paints and stamps their hat with elephants, stars, moons, and suns, and sends them home delighted.

potion.mechanic: A home-base workshop reached on foot through the forest and down Cornell Street — no potion needed; friends simply drop by to order a hat.

worlds.name: Cornell Street & New York City
worlds.curatedDescription: Cornell Street is the ordinary neighborhood road that doubles as a cosmic thoroughfare — bisected by a stark yellow line, cutting through the dense forest and stitching the earthly to the stars. It anchors local life, with Hattie's tree home, the residence of Uncle X, and a towering honey tree tended by just the right sort of bees, while also charting the flight path to the Mookers' planet. From a backyard garden, rocket ships blast off and fly down Cornell Street and on past Kitridge and Marigold Streets until they reach the planet, which turns out to sit just a few streets from home.

potion.mechanic: The neighborhood threshold where the earthly meets the cosmic — walked on foot for honey and errands, or used as the launch route flown up into space.

worlds.arrivalFrom: the frame — the everyday neighborhood road, and the launch route flown up to the Mookers' planet

worlds.name: The Forest
worlds.curatedDescription: The Forest is the whispering woodland that cloaks the green planet, laced with winding paths, secret gopher tunnels, and hidden mole cottages, and forming the essential route from Hattie's workshop toward the wizard's castle. Its sun-drenched edges are a sanctuary of foraging and play, but its deeper, darker thickets hold trouble: it is where a sick little mouse was found lying in a clearing, and where Mole once wandered too far after worms and got lost in the dark. Rescues here run on lanterns and flashlights, following a glow to a friend and then holding hands to walk safely home before bed.

potion.mechanic: An earthly woodland crossed on foot along the forest paths from home — no potion, just lanterns and flashlights to follow a glow in the dark.

worlds.arrivalFrom: home / the frame — reached on foot along the forest paths, and every rescue ends holding hands, walking home to bed

worlds.name: Dimitar’s Circular Island
worlds.curatedDescription: A perfectly circular island rising from distant waters, home to the purple dragonet Dimitar and villages of little dragonets, with a mountain at its center that is secretly a volcano. It hosts Ginger Catasorry, a school for cats and dragonets where students do planet maps, drawing, singing, snack time, and bead counting. When the volcano threatened to erupt, the ice dragon Icicle froze the entire island to stop it, and Seeker's friends melted the frost away with massive amounts of salt and warm water.

potion.mechanic: The circular island is a real, earthly place reached by flying there (on Seeker's magic ladder or sky ship), not by a teleporting potion.

worlds.name: Prehistoric World
worlds.curatedDescription: An ancient world reached by drinking Isabella's prehistoric-animals potion, which smells like ancient prehistoric creatures and mastodon fur. It is home to a meat-loving T-Rex, a slow, tea-drinking giant sloth who lives in a burrow, a woolly mammoth, and a fierce smilodon that turns out to just want belly rubs. Seeker, Jane, and a rainbow of Frasgles explore it, scaring off the scariest creatures with their loudest shouts before taking a going-home potion.

worlds.name: Underwater Coral Reef Gemstone World
worlds.curatedDescription: A vibrant submerged realm of coral and sparkling gemstones, reached by drinking a light-blue, fishy-smelling potion with little glittering sparkles from a diamond-shaped bottle. Seeker and Dematar appear beneath the surface, but Dematar's sudden coral allergy forces a sneezing retreat up onto the rocks and sand. Back on the surface, two little tropical fish, one red and one blue, turn up tangled in Seeker's beard and are adopted as pets.

worlds.name: The Elemental Planes
worlds.curatedDescription: A set of five elemental realms that Seeker maps using colored magic potions, each drink taking travelers to a different plane. The Plane of Fire is a scorching land of volcanoes, campfires, and bright hot lights floating through the air; the Plane of Ice is full of ice and snow; the Plane of Water is a world of water; the Plane of Grass has enormous fields of sweet-smelling grass that stretch as far as you can see; and the Plane of Mud is a sticky world where moles dig for bugs. In the signature story the Mischief Moles choose the fire potion and brave an erupting volcano, sheltering in a tunnel until a flame bird appears to guide them to the summit.

potion.rhyme: Higher and higher to the plane of fire.
potion.mechanic: Each of Seeker's swirling elemental potions carries the drinker to a different plane after a sip and a spoken chant, with a sip of clean pure water to return home.

worlds.name: Star World
worlds.curatedDescription: A breathtaking cosmic dimension set in the dark expanse of space, where travelers float in darkness surrounded on every side by the night sky full of tiny twinkling lights. It is home to the cat-like Mookers, and in Star World you can zoom across the cosmos very fast, star to star. At its heart glows a wise, ancient star, billions of years old, who watches planets come and go in a blink.

worlds.name: The Moon
worlds.curatedDescription: Visible from Earth as a pockmarked sphere of gray, white, and black, the Moon is a low-gravity world where visitors bounce as they walk. A big round gray-and-white-and-black circle in the sky, it is a waypoint for sun-bound crews and a playground of ancient space rocks and leaping Floofers. Its silver dust is where the long-lost mother cat is finally found.

potion.mechanic: Reached not by potion but by a homemade cardboard rocket ship that blasts off from Mars and dodges asteroids before landing on the Moon.

worlds.name: Mars
worlds.curatedDescription: A primordial red world of red rocks and dust underfoot, resting beneath a strange reddish-pink sky dotted with little wispy clouds. Being smaller than Earth, it has less gravity, so everyone feels lighter and can jump higher, and dust storms sweep across its ancient dormant volcanoes and impact craters. There is no air to breathe on Mars, so travelers carry a magic bubble of comfortable air with them; it is the home of Julian.

potion.name: Mars potion
potion.mechanic: Each traveler takes a sip of the swirling, spiraling red-orange-yellow-and-black potion, chants the magic spell three times, and a big zoom-pow sets them down on Mars inside a magic bubble of breathable air.

worlds.name: Planet of the Mookers
worlds.curatedDescription: An enigmatic alien world with a fuzzy yet curiously slimy surface, the ancestral cradle of the blue, friendly Mookers, moose-like creatures who talk in a rhythmic chorus of "mooks." Everything there is so slimy that visitors end up covered in sticky goo. The realm is strewn with the colossal remains of giant fossils and holds a library where ancient fossil books are kept, and it can be reached only by drinking a specific purple potion.

worlds.name: Balloon World
worlds.curatedDescription: Balloon World is a whimsical realm where everything is made of balloons, from the springy, rubbery, bouncy ground and rolling hills to its towering architecture and inflated delicacies. Its denizens include squeaking balloon dogs like Squeaky, who works at the Balloon Twisting School, and it is ruled by a giant rainbow-balloon King who wears an orange ring of balloons as a crown. Wonders include the majestic Balloon Castle and a balloon farm growing balloon strawberries and other balloon fruits and vegetables. It is the birthplace of the kitten Jinjar, infamously known as the 'Sneaky Popper.'

worlds.name: Slime World
worlds.curatedDescription: Slime World is a vibrant, magical realm where the landscape is sculpted from iridescent orange and blue slime, a viscous dimension that is wonderfully bouncy yet incredibly sticky, so lifting a foot goes 'shloop' and every fall rebounds softly. At its center stands a big, ball-shaped castle made of orange and blue slime, filled with fuzzy ball creatures called Snooper-ka-floopers (the Floofers' next cousins) and ruled by the Queen of Slime World. It is home to the blue-and-green alien Sneeter and hosts a Slime School, where students mix baking soda, glue and food coloring into gooey creations before bouncing through the sticky hills.

worlds.name: Cat World
worlds.curatedDescription: A tactile, fur-filled dimension reachable only through specialized teleportation potions, a plush realm for those who master alchemical teleportation. It is home to cats who speak in meows, purrs, and the occasional 'hate,' including a kitten named Silver who cannot open her own cans of food. To help, the wizard Seker leaves behind a magical can opener that makes a 'snergle' sound, so the cats of Cat World can learn to feed themselves.

worlds.name: Diamond World
worlds.curatedDescription: Diamond World is one of the fantastical destinations bottled in Uncle Grisco's potion closet. When Seeker discovers that Uncle Grisco keeps his own collection of potions, Diamond World is named among the possibilities alongside the Rainbow Forest, Barbie's Garden, and Izzy's house. On this night the travelers choose the Izzy's-house draught instead, so Diamond World stays a glittering, unvisited promise on the shelf.

potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking the Diamond World potion from Uncle Grisco's magical potion closet.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Well and Uncle Grisco said, there's a tickle-too-soup-to-cloud and the purple soup potions and there was one that would take us to the Diamond World, one that would take us to the Rainbow Forest, one that would take us to Barbie's Garden, and there would be one that would take us to Izzy's house.

stories.title: The Potion to the Little Hotel House

worlds.name: Sleepy World
worlds.curatedDescription: Sleepy World is the coziest world in the universe: a dim, calm realm beneath a beautiful starry sky, where mountains and piles of soft blankets and pillows lie everywhere and cozy beds wait in every shape, size, and color. It is watched over by Saluska, a huge, fluffy, blue sleep dragon with big, droopy eyes whose warm body and deep voice make every visitor feel sleepy. Saluska makes a perfectly custom, cozy bed appear for each traveler, so they can curl up, imagine the worlds of their ancestors, and drift off to sleep.

potion.name: Sleepy World potion
potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking a dark blue, swirly indigo potion speckled with glowing stars and saying the rhyme.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I want a pink bed with pink sheets with mice on them, and a pink blanket with purple stars, and, um, a cozy blue pillow.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And so, Seeker and Hattie appeared in the coziest world in the universe. It was Sleepy World.

stories.title: The Cozy Potions of Sleepy World

worlds.name: Winterworld
worlds.curatedDescription: Winterworld is a freezing landscape of deep snow and drifting snowflakes, dotted with hidden, experimental ice towers. It is perilous enough to swallow a traveler whole: Seeker finds the mouse Winston buried beneath the snow after a snow-angel mishap. Bundled in a jacket, snow pants, boots, mittens, and his magic shining hat, Seeker digs Winston free and recovers the tiny ice towers he had been searching for, leftovers of his experiment to build one gigantic tower.

potion.name: Winterworld potion
potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking the sparkling white snow potion while wearing all their winter gear.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: "Uh, I just fell down when I was making a snow angel."

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: "And I found some ice cubes and I found some ice towers."

stories.title: Winterworld Rescue and the Magic Shining Hat

worlds.name: Red Dot World
worlds.curatedDescription: Red Dot World is a raspberry-strawberry extravaganza where, in every direction as far as you can see, the ground is a soft, fluffy purple material dotted all over with little spots of red: raspberries, strawberries, currants, red grapes, cranberries, red floofberries, and red apples, anything red. Its one resident is a giant, friendly flying pterodactyl who has all the berries he could ever want but longs for meat and dreams of learning to dance. When Lottie the ballet-dancing bunny shares a picnic basket of meat and teaches him her moves, the lonely reptile of the berry world finds a friend.

potion.name: Red Dot World
potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking a purple, swirly potion covered in red dots, its cork labeled 'Red Dot World', and reciting the rhyme.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It's made of raspberries and strawberries.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I'm fine walking because Lottie can dance anywhere.

stories.title: Seeker's Midnight Adventure and the Dancing Pterodactyl

worlds.name: Floofer Cloud
worlds.curatedDescription: The Floofers' ancestral home, a distant realm of very soft, fluffy ground wrapped in a golden sparkly mist. Its inhabitants are tiny living pom-poms that bounce sky-high, shooting straight up and floating back down. They are so bursting with energy that they cannot stop jumping long enough to fall asleep, even when utterly exhausted.

potion.name: The golden sparkles potion
potion.rhyme: One so manya know, one so manya know, one so manya know.
potion.mechanic: Each traveler takes a sip of the sparkly golden teleportation potion and says the rhyme three times, vanishing in a poof and reappearing in the land of the Floofers.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Maybe the Fluffer cloud? No, the Floofer cloud.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Very good. And they can jump so high. Seeker, those are what Floofers are. They're very small.

worlds.name: Rainbow Forest
worlds.curatedDescription: A kaleidoscopic forest first charted by Seeker and reachable only through the alchemy of Uncle Grisco's potions, partitioned into radiant domains of red, orange, and gold. Beneath its shifting, vibrant canopies, travelers navigate the distinct chromatic sections in search of magical creatures lost within its shimmering depths - such as a wide-eyed, bouncy Floofer strayed from the Floofer Cloud.

potion.mechanic: Reached by one of Uncle Grisco's teleportation potions; across these tellings it is only named among his brews ('one that would take us to the Rainbow Forest'), never actually drunk on-screen.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: What about the Rainbow Forest? I remember that story.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Search for a lost Floofer.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: A Floofer is a ball which loves to blink so high. It has eyes in it and, um, and sometimes it can't fall asleep.

worlds.name: Kingdom of the Sea Mice
worlds.curatedDescription: A mysterious kingdom of tiny sea mice hidden on the absolute ocean floor, deep in the crushing silence of the deep dark. To reach it, a submersible dives down out of the bright, sparkling sunlit zone into ever colder, darker water, gliding past sleepy deep-sea creatures like a grumpy anglerfish, all the way to the bottom of the sea where the Sea Mice live.

potion.mechanic: No potion - a crewed submersible dives from the sunlit zone down through the cold, dark abyss to the Sea Mice's kingdom on the ocean floor.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: We're just going, I don't know, maybe we're going to, we're going to the bottom of the sea to see where the Kingdom of the Sea Mice live.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I see, I see a big anglerfishy!

worlds.name: Kingdom of the Ants
worlds.curatedDescription: The Kingdom of the Ants is a massive, bustling city hidden deep underground, stumbled upon by the Mischief Moles as they dug a tunnel past a cave and through deep, mucky mud. Millions of ants scurry this way and that along the floor, the walls, and the ceiling, building little buildings, tending their eggs, growing new babies, and storing food, while their friends the worms wiggle through the dirt. Below the kingdom lies an even deeper chamber where a big wooden box of sparkling gemstones was buried.

potion.mechanic: Reached not by potion but by digging a tunnel straight down from a cave, back-tracking around a dead end of mucky mud, until a mole's claw punches through the dirt into the open underground chamber.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Ants and worms.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And there was, and there was worms wiggling about.

stories.title: The Mischief Moles and the Kingdom of the Ants

worlds.name: Silver’s Planet
worlds.curatedDescription: Silver's Planet is a far-off world in the galaxy where kittens reside, home to a kitten named Silver. Captain Izzy pilots a rocket ship there for a playdate, flying around big space rocks and doing research on space rocks along the way before a careful 'down to landoff' landing. Silver greets her visitors with purrs and treats, and the mission ends with a countdown and a blast off all the way back to Earth.

potion.mechanic: Reached by rocket ship on a long flight through space, dodging giant space rocks, before a slow 'down to landoff' descent onto the planet's surface.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Down to landoff! Down to landoff! Down to landoff, everybody!

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: No. It said, 'Silver, what's wrong?' And Silver said 'Meow, meow, I want to play!'

stories.title: Mission to Silver's Planet

worlds.name: Yuck World
worlds.curatedDescription: Yuck World is a messy destination that appears in this tale only as a bottled potion resting on the shelf of Seeker's potion closet, named the 'Muck and Yuck World potion.' It sits among other brews Seeker rummages past, like a Planet of the Mookers potion and a Floofer Cloud potion, and is reached by drinking that one specific potion. On this adventure, though, Seeker and Disco chose the Izzy's Attic potion instead, leaving Yuck World corked for another day.

potion.name: Muck and Yuck World potion
potion.mechanic: Reached by drinking the 'Muck and Yuck World potion' kept on the shelf of Seeker's potion closet (unused in this story, where the travelers pick the Izzy's Attic potion instead).

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: oh, the Muck and Yuck World potion.
